speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease)

The combination of pruritic facial rash, hypopigmented macules on the elbows, loss of eyebrows and eyelashes, and symmetric numbness/tingling in the palms is highly characteristic of leprosy. Given your history of working on a rice farm and with livestock, exposure is plausible. Do you have any known contact with someone who had leprosy, and have you noticed any facial muscle weakness or asymmetry?
